_comment: Canon spine shared across Soul Land projects. Confidence is stated honestly: nothing here was read in the Chinese original, so [canon] means multiple independent secondary sources agree.

rank_ladder.subdivisions: Titled Douluo splits 91-94 ordinary, 95-98 Super Douluo, 99 Limit Douluo.
rank_ladder.known_error: The correct term at 71-80 is Soul Sage, not Soul Saint. That error was caught and corrected in the kit.

optimal_nine_ring: Two yellow, two purple, five black. A character exceeding that is exceptional and must stay exceptional on the page - never silently corrected downward.

beast_law.warning: Load-bearing for any plant-beast protagonist, which makes these the most dangerous facts in the system: heavily used, thinly sourced. Flag any chapter whose logic collapses without them.

user_rulings.ruling: Blue Silver Valley / Blue Silver Emperor Valley IS canon Soul Land 1.
user_rulings.note: This wording was revoked once and must not be re-added.

user_rulings.ruling: Born approximately 1837 DC. Never move this anchor.
user_rulings.formula: DC is approximately 1837 plus his age in years.

filename_law: ASCII letters, digits, underscores and dots only. No spaces, no special characters, no non-ASCII. Upload-safe names survive transfer between agents and platforms.
